metadata.title: MedOrbits Notifications
metadata.description: Site-wide banners, alerts and reminder templates shown to visitors. Official admission notices live in news.json; notifications point to them.
metadata.privacyPolicy: Notifications must not contain personal data. Delivery to individuals requires consent and an opt-out.

templates.title: Deadline approaching
templates.message: The listed deadline for {{admissionName}} may be approaching. Check the official notice for the current date.
templates.note: Never insert a deadline date unless it comes from a verified record.

templates.title: New update available
templates.message: A new update about {{topic}} has been added. Review the official notice before taking action.

templates.title: Schedule may have changed
templates.message: The schedule for {{topic}} has been updated. Confirm the latest dates on the official website.

templates.title: Prepare your documents
templates.message: Review the official notice for the documents required for {{admissionName}}.

templates.title: Information not yet verified
templates.message: Some details here are not yet verified. Confirm with the official source before acting.

dataRules: Every notification must have a unique id; templateId, when set, must reference an existing template.
title and message are required; keep messages short, factual and in plain text.
Never invent dates, deadlines, results or eligibility; deadline-related messages must link to a verified admission or news record.
A deadline_reminder, schedule_change or result_alert must reference at least one of newsId or admissionIds.
startsAt and endsAt use ISO 8601 with offset; endsAt must not precede startsAt.
Notifications past endsAt must be treated as expired and not shown.
channel 'email' or 'push' requires audience 'subscribers' or 'registered_users' and recorded user consent with an opt-out.
Never include personal data, phone numbers or email addresses in notification content.
Do not use urgency or fear to pressure users; severity 'critical' is reserved for outages and verified, time-sensitive official changes.
Notifications must not promise admission, jobs, funding or outcomes.
cta urls must be https or a site-relative path, and external links must point to official sources where an official notice exists.
Referenced ids (stateIds, examIds, courseIds, admissionIds, newsId) must exist.
verificationStatus 'verified' is required before a notification about an official change goes live.
The active field controls display only; it does not mean anything is open or in force.

displayRules.accessibility: Banners use role=status; critical alerts use role=alert; never rely on colour alone.
